world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Выдрин В.Ф. 2017. Манде языки. In: Языки мира: Языки манде. СПб.: Нестор-История, pp. 16-45.
sources.note: Family-level only, p. 34: 'Ударение в большинстве М.я. отсутствует. Там, где оно может быть выделено (в частности, бамана), его функциональная нагрузка невелика.' Names Bobo as an exception to the 2-tone norm of Western Mande. The volume has no Bobo chapter (preface lists Bobo among the three languages without an article).

sources.citation: WALS Online, lect bbf 'Bobo Madaré (Northern)' (values table). https://wals.info/languoid/lect/wals_code_bbf
sources.note: Only feature 13A 'Complex tone system' (citing Le Bris & Prost 1981 and Morse 1976, both descriptions of Southern Bobo/sya); no stress features (14A-17A) coded.

sources.citation: Prost, André. 1983. Essai de description grammaticale du dialecte bobo de Tansila, Haute-Volta. Mandenkan 5: 1-101.
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: open copy online
sources.note: Nothing. Chapitre I 'Phonologie' (printed/PDF pp. 5-10) covers vowels, consonants and 1.3 'Les tonèmes' (three level tones H/M/L, all contour combinations, plus a downstepped low); Chapitre II treats noun tone sandhi. No mention of stress/accent d'intensité anywhere; 'accent(s)' occurs only on p. 65 (13.13) meaning tone diacritics ('voyelles porteuses d'accents modulés').
